decisions.reason: As a core door lever handle family that supports specification continuity and coordinated system selling, it is likely to stay in the range unless demand has materially disappointed.
The mitred door lever handle family strengthens the firm's design-led architectural portfolio and would normally be retained to preserve choice for planners and projects.
This multifunctional door lever handle remains somewhat more niche, but it still fits the firm's accessibility and integrated-solution strategy well enough to justify keeping it.
The door and window handle collection appears to be a flagship family with award-backed visibility, so management would be very unlikely to withdraw it within a year.

A finish is easier to rationalize than a full hardware family, but this light patinated bronze option still supports the firm's premium architecture-oriented offering and is more likely to be kept than dropped.
